main_text.p: tis ac turbidis prolixè respon-debo : hicenim tria verba suf-fecerint. Interim exspectabo quid responsi DD. deputati Ultrajectini in causa Marefii; à DD. Deputatis Groninga-nis sint laturi, & an in eo acquiescere debeamus. Quòd si necillo, noftro desiderio, in abstersionem omnium eorum quae in nos injuriâ dicta, fiat satis;(praesertim cùm nuperrimè in ejusdem Marefii Apologia pro Salmasio, mendacia eadem sint reposita, in quibus manifestè à DD. deputatis Ultrajectinis, est deprehensus : scil. quod Rev. Parenti omnia velit imputari quae illo inscio à me conscripta & edita :) neque innocentiae atque honoris virorum bonorum habeatur ratio ; occasionem mihi datam exiftumavero, quâ singulis reponam quod debeam, & vel bigam, vel tri-gam

page.notes: The scan is slightly blurred at the line ends, so "hicenim", "suf-fecerint" and "exiftumavero" are read from the letter shapes and could be off by a letter. The word "necillo" is printed as one word and is copied as such. The faint text in the bottom right corner is a digitiser's watermark and is not transcribed. No marginal notes are printed on this page.
